Setup instructions

Use the original source instructions for this capability; a dedicated SkillLantern walkthrough is not available yet.

Original installation instructions

  1. Claude Code route: read the official repository, then run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills. Use /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills; this installs the named collection, not just one file.
  2. Give the local app URL and one behavior to verify. Expect actual browser assertions, screenshots/logs and a pass/fail report.
Check before keeping it

Ask for one small result, inspect the output and permissions, and confirm it suits your app. If it fails, undo your changes and return to your original project.
